data.title: 星熊 · 茶馆的一局
data.description: 棋局拖得比预想久，她端起茶杯，又把棋子放回原处。想好下一步后，星熊抬眼催你别走神。
data.promptProse: Inside a traditional Lungmen tea house with carved wooden lattices, Hoshiguma sits thoughtfully at a low square table, poised with a wooden game piece between her fingers above an ongoing board game. Steaming cups of jasmine tea and small ceramic teapots rest beside the board, while diffuse window light filters through bamboo blinds, creating an atmosphere of cozy, strategic rivalry.
data.animaCaption: Seated at a low wooden table in a quiet tea house, she pauses with a game piece poised between her fingers over the board beside steaming jasmine teacups. Diffuse daylight filters through bamboo blinds across her focused face.
